text:
Rowan C.: Heads up — OrbitLogistics showing onboarding stall (4/9 steps), weekly token volume -45% vs baseline, renewal in 18 days. I want to run a 7-day mini-sprint save: fast probes, micro fixes, then an opt-in soft-landing if unresolved. Thoughts?

Elena V.: Agree. Keep it minimal: (1) automated probes + non-disruptive fixes, (2) 20-min enablement & eval, (3) soft-landing downgrade w/ credit. Template comms only.

Marcus J.: Proposed Tiered mini-sprint:
Tier A (0-36h): probes + auto-fixes
- route cache ttl 10s->75s
- enable prefix caching on onboarding routes
- small-batch mode (batch_size=6)
- webhook retry cap=3 + jitter
- 3% canary for 6h
Tier B (36h-4d): enablement + quick eval
- 20-min call, walk prompts, share 100-shot eval vs quantized candidate
- dashboard with p50/p95/session tokens/webhook errors
Tier C (4-7d): soft-landing opt-in
- offer reduced-concurrency API key + 20% usage credit for 30d
- clear revert button and rollback snippet

Rowan C.: Nice. Marcus, can you run the quick audit and canary? Elena, can you draft the two-line outreach? I'll prepare the CRM note.

Marcus J.: Audit snapshot: p50=0.88s (baseline 0.7s), p95=3.2s, KV hit 44%, webhook 18 retries last 48h. Pushing cache + prefix to staging now.

Elena V.: Outreach draft: "Hi Orbit team — we saw onboarding pause and rolled a small perf fix that often resolves timeouts. Could we do a 20-min check-in or would you prefer async notes?" Sent with calendar link.

Marcus J.: Staged cache change -> KV hit in staging 70%, p95 improved ~500ms. Started 3% canary in prod.

KB-Bot: reminder scheduled -> review canary metrics in 6h for thread 3400123456.

Rowan C.: Success criteria = restore active onboarding flow to within 10% of baseline OR secure soft-landing opt-in with credits + rollback path. If unresolved by renewal -7d escalate to renewals ops.

CS-Ops: recorded play as "mini-sprint-save: soft-landing" and added checklist in playbooks.

Marcus J.: I'll run eval (regen=1,temp=0.15) and post a short summary.

Elena V.: I'll host enablement and capture feedback.

Rowan C.: Thanks team — keep comms tight and let's close within 7 days. :rocket:
